sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A bottle of cloudy, unrefined sake. Sake is a drink meant for sharing.
This cloudy sake is one of Isshin Ashin's favorites. It has a rich, full-bodied flavor.
On the other hand, it has a reputation for getting one too drunk, too quickly.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Can be offered to Isshin Ashina, the Sculptor or Emma for additional dialogues.
